headline: Divgi Torqtransfer Systems Limited: Substantial Acquisition Disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4)
sum: Divgi Torqtransfer Systems has filed a mandatory disclosure of substantial acquisition under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4)—indicating a significant shareholding change or takeover bid triggering formal regulator notification to NSE.
detail: Under SEBI SAST Regulations 2011 Reg 31(4), an acquiror or person acting in concert must disclose to the stock exchange within 4 trading days of crossing 25%, 51%, or 75% shareholding. The NSE filing on 19 Jun 2026 confirms such a disclosure was submitted; the specific acquiror identity, shareholding % crossed, offer price/terms, and any conditions precedent are embedded in the filed Form DIS (Disclosure Form) which requires direct access to the SEBI/NSE portal or company disclosures for full detail.
